title: Insert Interval
statement: `intervals` is a sorted list of non-overlapping intervals. Insert `new_interval` and merge whatever overlaps it. Return the sorted result.
constraints: intervals are sorted by start and do not overlap
hints: Copy every interval that ends before the new one starts.
Merge every interval that overlaps the new one by expanding its start and end.
Then append the merged interval and copy the rest unchanged.

approaches.name: Append and run merge-intervals
approaches.explanation: Ignores the fact that the input is already sorted.

editorial: Because the input is sorted and disjoint, overlap is a single contiguous run. Skip the prefix that ends before new_interval starts. Fold the overlapping run into one interval. Append the untouched suffix. No full sort is required.
reference_solution:
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from collections import Counter, OrderedDict, defaultdict, deque
import heapq

def insert(intervals: list[list[int]], new_interval: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    out: list[list[int]] = []
    i = 0
    start, end = new_interval
    while i < len(intervals) and intervals[i][1] < start:
        out.append(intervals[i])
        i += 1
    while i < len(intervals) and intervals[i][0] <= end:
        start = min(start, intervals[i][0])
        end = max(end, intervals[i][1])
        i += 1
    out.append([start, end])
    out.extend(intervals[i:])
    return out
